source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.7
text: Single-nutrient inorganic fertilizers may be combined or mixed together (into compound form) at the same time, giving farmers a choice in how they apply fertilizer based on the actual, practical nutrient needs of the crop.

source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.8
text: Common commercial inorganic fertilizer products used for rice, by category: Single-nutrient fertilizer (ជីទោល) — Urea (ជីអុីយរ៉េ): Nitrogen (N) 46%; Potassium chloride / Muriate of Potash (ជីប៉ូតាស្យូមក្លរួ, also called Kali/MOP): K2O 60%. Compound/mixed fertilizer (ជីសមាស) — DAP (ជីដេអាប៉ែ) 18-46-0: N 18%, P 46%; fertilizer 16-20-0: N 16%, P 20%; fertilizer 15-15-15: N 15%, P 15%, K 15%.
